passage.label: We conferred favor upon Moses and Aaron and saved them and their people from the great affliction; We supported them so it was they who overcame; We gave them the explicit Scripture and guided them on the straight path; left favorable mention among later generations; peace upon Moses and Aaron; thus We reward the doers of good; they were of Our believing servants; Elias was among the messengers, when he said to his people will you not fear Allah, do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators, Allah your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers; they denied him so they will be brought for punishment except the chosen servants; left favorable mention; peace upon Elias; thus We reward the doers of good; he was of Our believing servants; Lot was among the messengers, when We saved him and his family all except his wife among those who remained; then We destroyed the others; you pass by them in the morning and at night, then will you not use reason; Jonah was among the messengers, when he ran away to the laden ship and drew lots and was among the losers; the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy; had he not been of those who exalt Allah he would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected; We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill and caused a gourd vine to grow over him; We sent him to a hundred thousand or more and they believed so We gave them enjoyment of life for a time

arabicExcerpts.text: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Musa and Harun granted favor, rescue from great affliction, support producing victory, the explicit Scripture and straight-path guidance, closed by mention, peace and the muhsin formula; Ilyas confronting Ba'l worship with the taqwa question and the appeal to the best of creators as Lord of them and their forefathers, denial bringing presentation for punishment with the chosen-servant exemption; Lut's household rescued except the wife counted among those remaining, the destroyed sites passed morning and night as a reasoning challenge; Yunus fleeing to the laden ship, losing the lot and being swallowed while blameworthy, his prior tasbih preventing confinement until resurrection, the sick shore-casting shaded by a gourd vine, and a mission to a hundred thousand or more whose belief earned temporal enjoyment
